description: 对手叠上反应层数那么多层【菌血】：每次恢复生命减半，实际回了几点就叠几层【中毒】；N 层持续 N 秒（层数不掉），再反应就加层加秒。

descriptions.en: The opponent gains Fungal Blood equal to the reaction stacks: every heal is halved, and they gain one stack of Poison per point actually healed. N stacks last N seconds (stacks don't drop); reacting again adds stacks and seconds.
